Card Q&A.q: One of my opponent's Digimon attacks,  activates twice from both a [When Attacking] effect and an inherited effect, and their hand increases by 2 cards. Will this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect trash 2 of my opponent's cards in their hand?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it activates. This card's effect trashes the number of cards that were drawn.In the example given in the question, after trashing 2 cards from their hand, your opponent would trash an additional 2 cards, for a total of 4 cards trashed.
